name: SwingLog · Flight S
concept: Ivory golf ball, gold S-shaped swing trail, forest-green full-bleed background

initialGeneration.prompt: Design ONE finished premium mobile app icon for SwingLog, a golf swing practice app. A perfectly SQUARE full-bleed opaque canvas, designed as a real production icon, NOT a mockup or presentation board. Deep rich forest green background, approximately #174B34, with very subtle tonal depth. Center a bold sculptural gold swing trail that curves like a single flowing abstract S, rising dynamically from the lower-left toward a bright ivory golf ball at upper-right. The trail should have one elegant countercurve, a broad polished warm-gold ribbon body with a tapered tail, and clean deep-green negative space; visually read as both a golf ball in flight and an S gesture. White/ivory ball is generously sized, understated realistic dimples, softly dimensional satin material, immediately recognizable at small size. Warm gold approximately #E9BC63, ivory #FFFCED. Shape and contrast carry the design, not tiny detail. Confident contemporary sports brand, memorable silhouette, energetic but controlled, refined lighting. Composition IMPORTANT: all ball and gold foreground elements entirely inside the central 76% diameter safe circle centered on the square, so both circular Android masks and iOS rounded-square clipping retain the complete symbol. Ball centered near x65%,y34%, diameter24%; trail ends around x27%,y72%. Leave generous dark green outer margins. Background reaches ALL FOUR square corners: no transparent pixels, no pre-rounded corners, no outer frame. NO typography, letters, wordmarks, numbers, flags, books, clubs, scenery, gradients of text, sparkle stars, lens flares, glow, concentric rings, extra balls or logos. Crisp anti-aliased high-quality app artwork with warm 3D material depth, not flat line art. Deliver just the single square icon.

selectedGeneration.prompt: Keep this exact SwingLog app-icon design, same golf ball, same gold S-shaped swing ribbon, same materials, lighting, colors and full-bleed opaque forest-green square background. Make ONLY this production-safety adjustment: scale the complete ball-and-ribbon foreground group down by about EIGHT PERCENT around the center of the square, so every gold or ivory pixel, including the lower-left tapered tail, fits comfortably within a circle centered on the square with radius 37 percent of the square width. Do not add a visible circle or border. Keep the icon beautifully balanced and the same relative geometry of ball and S ribbon. Keep corners square, not pre-rounded. No text, no extra elements. The background still reaches every corner.

exports: scripts/export_app_icon.py performs only mechanical resizing and PNG encoding; no retouching or redrawing

safeZone.method: Gold/ivory pixel threshold: R > 70 and R > .95G; visual circle and rounded-square checks supplement it

reviewLimit: Browser previews only; no installed iPhone/Android launcher refresh verified
originalPathsNote: Generated originals remain in workspace; committed master.png is the portable reference for future edits
